title: Natural finite affine coordinates for a Frobenius vector bundle
statement: Let p be a prime, S a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme over F_p [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], E a finite locally free O_S-module, and F an additive endomorphism of its sectionwise-universe-lifted abelian etale sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] satisfying F(ae)=a^p F(e) on every small-etale object. For every such object U and point x in U, there is an affine open neighbourhood A of x in U, a natural number n, a matrix c over Γ(A,O_A), and additive equivalences e_V:E_et(V)≃Γ(V,O_V)^n for every V→A. Here E_et is restricted along A→U→S. These equivalences commute with every etale restriction, F(s)_i=sum_j V*(c_ij)s_j^p in these coordinates, and p=0 in Γ(A,O_A).

proof.text: Choose natural scalar-compatible finite affine frame coordinates.

Evaluate F on the basis at the identity etale object to define a matrix. Naturality identifies its coefficients on every etale V. Expand any tuple as the sum of its scalar multiples of the standard basis. Additivity and p-semilinearity give the matrix formula. The structure map to Spec F_p gives p=0 in the ring of sections.

theorem frobenius_vectorBundle_local_coordinates
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (S : Scheme.{u})
    [S.Over (Spec (.of (ULift.{u} (ZMod p))))] [CompactSpace S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (E : S.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (F : (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E) ⟶
      (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
        (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E))
    (hF : ∀ (U : S.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a : ULift.{u + 1} Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤))
        (e : ULift.{u + 1} Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)),
      F.hom.app U (ULift.up (a.down • e.down)) =
        ULift.up (a.down ^ p • (@id Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.unop.hom).obj E, ⊤)
          (F.hom.app U e).down))) :
    ∀ (U : S.Etale) (x : U.left),
      ∃ (A : U.left.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen A), x ∈ A ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → Fin n → Γ(A.toScheme, ⊤)),
      let L := Etale.localizationRestriction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (A.ι ≫ U.hom) inferInstance
      let G := (sheafCompose S.smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf E)
      ∃ e : ∀ V : A.toScheme.Etale,
          (L.obj G).obj.obj (op V) ≃+ (Fin n → Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
        (p : Γ(A.toScheme, ⊤)) = 0 ∧
        (∀ (V W : A.toScheme.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V) (s : (L.obj G).obj.obj (op V)),
          ∀ i, e W ((L.obj G).obj.map g.op s) i = g.left.appTop (e V s i)) ∧
        (∀ (V : A.toScheme.Etale) (s : (L.obj G).obj.obj (op V)),
          ∀ i, e V ((L.map F).hom.app (op V) s) i =
            ∑ j, (@id Γ(V.left, ⊤) (V.hom.appTop (c i j))) * (e V s j) ^ p)
